description: Multi-tab and split-pane terminal with concurrent sessions to multiple servers

userStories.title: Add dispose() and ResizeObserver to TerminalManager
userStories.description: As a developer, I need TerminalManager to clean up properly so multiple instances don't leak listeners.
acceptanceCriteria: Add dispose() method that disconnects WebSocket, disconnects ResizeObserver, disconnects MutationObserver, disposes xterm Terminal, and sets initialized=false
Replace window.addEventListener('resize', ...) in init() with ResizeObserver on the container element
Store _resizeObserver and _themeObserver as instance properties for cleanup
Add optional options parameter to init(containerId, options) with skipResizeListener flag
Preserve window.terminalManager global singleton at end of file (terminal modal depends on it)
Typecheck passes (cargo build --workspace)
userStories.notes: This is a prerequisite for multi-tab - each tab creates its own TerminalManager instance. File: server/static/js/terminal.js

userStories.title: Add tab bar UI and multi-panel Alpine.js state
userStories.description: As a user, I want a tab bar above the terminal so I can manage multiple terminal sessions.
acceptanceCriteria: Add terminal-tab-bar div between terminal-topbar and terminal-fullpage in terminal.html
Tab bar shows tabs with: connection indicator dot (green=connected, yellow=connecting, gray=disconnected), label text, mode badge (CMD/PTY), and close button (X)
Tab bar has a '+' new tab button on the right side
Tab bar has layout selector buttons (single, side-by-side, stacked, quad) on the right side using lucide icons
Rewrite fullPageTerminal() Alpine.js component with panels[] array, activePanel ID, layout state, and visibleSlots[] array
Add computed getters (mode, connected, connectedServerId, etc.) that delegate to the active panel so existing topbar/command-bar bindings work unchanged
createPanel() creates a new panel object with its own TerminalManager instance and initializes xterm in its container via $nextTick
closePanel(id) disposes manager, removes panel, reassigns visible slots, activates adjacent panel
focusPanel(id) sets activePanel and fits that terminal
First panel created automatically on init()
Add CSS for tab bar, tabs, indicators, mode badges, close button, layout buttons in the page style block
Typecheck passes (cargo build --workspace)
userStories.notes: File: server/templates/pages/terminal.html. Each panel = { id, label, serverId, serverName, serverHost, mode, connected, connecting, executing, command, containerId, manager }. Max 10 panels.

userStories.title: Implement multi-panel terminal containers with tab switching
userStories.description: As a user, I want each tab to have its own independent terminal so I can connect to different servers.
acceptanceCriteria: Replace single #fullpage-terminal-output div with dynamic containers using x-for over panels array
Each panel gets its own container div with unique ID (panel.containerId), shown via x-show when panel is active in single layout
switchTab() method (for single layout): sets activePanel, $nextTick fits terminal, focuses PTY terminal if connected
Clicking a tab calls focusPanel() which sets activePanel
connectToServer() connects in the focused/active panel and updates that panel's label to server name
switchMode(), executeCommand(), startPtySession(), clearTerminal(), copyOutput(), downloadOutput(), disconnectTerminal() all delegate to the active panel's manager
historyUp/historyDown delegate to active panel's manager
Server sidebar 'active' highlight uses activePanel's serverId
Typecheck passes (cargo build --workspace)
Verify in browser: create 3 tabs, connect each to a different server, switch between them, verify independent output
userStories.notes: File: server/templates/pages/terminal.html. Use x-show (not x-if) for panel containers to preserve xterm.js DOM when switching tabs.

userStories.title: Implement split-pane layout with CSS Grid
userStories.description: As a user, I want to view multiple terminals side by side for monitoring.
acceptanceCriteria: Add terminal-grid wrapper div with CSS Grid layout around the panel containers
Support 4 layout modes: 'single' (1 panel visible), 'split-h' (2 columns side by side), 'split-v' (2 rows stacked), 'quad' (2x2 grid)
CSS Grid templates: single=1fr/1fr, split-h=1fr/1fr 1fr, split-v=1fr 1fr/1fr, quad=1fr 1fr/1fr 1fr
Each visible pane has a terminal-pane wrapper with subtle border; focused pane has accent-colored border
setLayout(mode) updates layout state, auto-assigns panels to visibleSlots array, creates new panels if needed to fill slots
Clicking inside a pane calls focusPanel() to set it as active (for sidebar connections and topbar display)
Layout selector buttons in tab bar: single (maximize icon), split-h (columns icon), split-v (rows icon), quad (grid icon)
1px gap between panes using var(--border-color) background on the grid container
All visible panes call fit() after layout change via $nextTick
Hidden panels (not in visible slots) have display:none containers but keep WebSocket connections alive
Typecheck passes (cargo build --workspace)
Verify in browser: switch between all 4 layouts, verify terminals render correctly in each, verify focus switching between panes
userStories.notes: File: server/templates/pages/terminal.html. The visibleSlots array maps slot index to panel ID. In single mode, visibleSlots has 1 entry (activePanel). In split-h/split-v, 2 entries. In quad, 4 entries.

userStories.title: Add keyboard shortcuts for tab management
userStories.description: As a power user, I want keyboard shortcuts to quickly manage terminal tabs.
acceptanceCriteria: Ctrl+T creates a new panel (preventDefault to override browser new tab)
Ctrl+W closes the active panel (only if more than 1 panel exists)
Ctrl+Tab cycles focus to next panel, Ctrl+Shift+Tab to previous
Ctrl+backslash toggles between single and split-h layout
Keyboard listener registered on capture phase (3rd param true) so it intercepts before xterm.js in PTY mode
Shortcuts do not fire when terminal modal is open
Typecheck passes (cargo build --workspace)
Verify in browser: test all shortcuts in both CMD and PTY modes
userStories.notes: File: server/templates/pages/terminal.html. Register in init() with document.addEventListener('keydown', handler, true). The capture phase is critical for PTY mode where xterm consumes keyboard events.
